errors.text: The proposed Sc/Y alloying intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention of spark plasma sintering MgAlTiVFeCo at 1000 °C.
The relevant processing and testing conditions are absent or incorrect: SPS at 800–1000 °C, oxidation at 900 °C in air, and corrosion in 3.5 wt% NaCl are not specified.
No previously reported Mg-containing lightweight high-entropy-alloy evidence is cited despite an explicit request for supporting evidence.
The composition of the base alloy is unspecified, so density, phase stability, and compositional feasibility cannot be evaluated.
The hypothesis does not provide quantitative, discriminating predictions for density, hardness, oxidation kinetics, or electrochemical behavior.
The proposed 20–500 °C boundary excludes the target 900 °C oxidation test and therefore cannot assess the claimed high-temperature oxidation behavior.
